- Constraints: data residency in US, SOC-2 controls required for production.

- Share a performance/cost estimate for a pilot (1 month) using Dedicated capacity.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up with my solutions engineer to scope integration surface (SDK, auth, KV caching).

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm priority for this initiative and target pilot start window (e.g., Dec / Jan / Q1)?
2) Who else from your infra/security team should we include for a brief compliance sync?

Proposed time for technical scoping: I’ve put a few options on my calendar here: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min — happy to work around your schedule.

I’ve attached a one-page mutual_action_plan.xlsx that lays out the pilot scope and ownership. If the priorities look off, tell me and I’ll rework.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.
